edges: Mary was unlikely to have a family waiting for her

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: Mary Magdalene was not one of Jesus' most devoted followers.
Joseph of Arimathea removed Jesus from the cross
Mary Magdalene traveled with Jesus despite having a husband and children at home
Joseph of Arimathea and Nicodemus supported Jesus' ministry financially
Jesus foreshadowed his fate by stating the anointing would be useful for his burial.
Jesus stated that the poor would always be present.
Jesus instructed the Twelve Apostles to abandon their jobs and join him on a mission.
Jesus told Judas to leave her alone.
